summary: The MaintCourseDetailsCompetency class handles user interface elements for managing course competencies in a web application. It includes controls and logic for displaying, editing, and saving competency data via a grid view and modal popups.
purpose: To provide a user interface for viewing and managing course competencies, allowing users to edit and save competencies through a structured web component.

workflows.name: Edit Competencies
steps: User clicks 'Edit All' button if screen is editable.
Competency grid view enters edit mode.
User modifies competency levels using dropdown lists.
User saves changes, triggering update to Competency list.

business_rules: Hide 'Edit All' button if the screen is not editable.
validations: Verify UserSession is not null before selecting competencies.
conditions: If UserSession is null, cancel data selection.
system_behavior: Bind glossary hyperlinks to competency grid.
Redirect user after competencies are updated.
